# Business Builder
> Custom Apps, Graphic Design, Social Media Management & Twitter Automation

Business Builder is a digital agency helping small and medium businesses grow
their online presence through custom web applications, professional graphic
design, social media management, and AI-powered Twitter/X automation.

## Services
- [Custom Applications](https://business-builder.online/) — Bespoke web and mobile applications built for your specific business needs
- [Graphic Design](https://business-builder.online/) — Brand identity, marketing materials, and visual content
- [Social Media Management](https://business-builder.online/) — Multi-platform content strategy and posting
- [Twitter Automation](https://business-builder.online/) — AI agent that posts and engages on X/Twitter daily
- [Content Creation](https://business-builder.online/) — Written and visual content for digital channels
- [Digital Marketing](https://business-builder.online/) — Strategy, advertising, and growth campaigns

## Pricing
- Essentials: $99/month — 2 weekly posts, 1 platform, email support
- Growth: $249/month — AI Twitter agent, 3 platforms, 2 weekly posts, 1 video per month
- Enterprise: $499/month — AI Twitter agent, 4 platforms, 4 weekly posts, 3 videos per month
